summary: Verified DashboardPage changes for client portal on web: (1) 'Investor Suitability Questionnaire' is removed from Sign Documents tab (backend /api/documents returns only nda/engagement/kyc; frontend grid additionally filters /investor|questionnaire/i as a belt-and-suspenders), (2) Upload Documents tab now exposes a per-row delete control alongside download. All 5 backend pytest cases pass (documents sanity, upload+delete+persist, 404 on unknown id, cross-user 403, owner download) and the full web UI flow (login → sign tab → upload → delete → page reload → sign tab recheck) passes.
critical_code_review_comments: DashboardPage.jsx:35 — api.delete('/uploads/'+id) is correct; UI deleting state (deletingId) prevents double-click. Good.

DashboardPage.jsx:272 — client-side belt-and-suspenders filter on /investor|questionnaire/i works even if an admin later re-adds an investor doc via db.sign_documents. If that is intentional defence-in-depth it is fine; otherwise consider dropping the server-side DEFAULT_SIGN_DOCS fallback semantics (currently if any sign_documents row exists it REPLACES the default list — a single stray investor row in Mongo would still be filtered out thanks to the client filter).

server.py:1559 DELETE /api/uploads/{id} — soft-delete only (sets is_deleted=True). Storage object is NOT deleted. This is fine for audit, but worth noting that disk/object-store usage will grow unbounded. Consider a background cleanup task for is_deleted=True older than N days.
server.py:1526 /uploads/mine filters is_deleted=False — matches delete semantics. Good.
server.py:1559 DELETE allows soft-deleting an already-soft-deleted file: find_one filter is {is_deleted: False} so a second DELETE returns 404 — consistent.
